mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sensory route was most worthwhile because it connected the opening question to a concrete mechanism: sensors register different muscle lengths and send information back to the nervous system.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the control system to the nerve-linked arm felt somewhat procedural, although the resulting picture made the missing return route clear.

surprise.text: The distinction between sensing limb position and locating an unseen target sharpened my understanding of what the muscle sensors can contribute.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the outgoing and returning routes made me curious about how the body coordinates movement and responds to its surroundings.
